title.en: Democrat Mary Peltola and Republican Dan Sullivan lead in Alaska primary for US Senate – US politics live
title.zh: 民主党人玛丽·佩尔托拉和共和党人丹·沙利文在阿拉斯加州美国参议院初选中领先——美国政治直播

summary.en: Incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola are leading in the Alaska primary for the US Senate, setting the stage for a November election showdown. Peltola aims to flip the seat and help Democrats gain control of Congress.
summary.zh: 在阿拉斯加州参议院初选中，现任共和党参议员丹·沙利文和民主党人玛丽·佩尔托拉领先，为11月的决选奠定基础。佩尔托拉旨在赢得该席位，帮助民主党重新掌控国会。

body.en: Incumbent Sullivan is running for third term while Peltola is fighting to flip seat and aid Democrats retake control of Congress Democratic socialist Angie Nixon clinches surprise win in Florida Sign up for the US Breaking News email Those unfamiliar with Alaska politics are likely raising an eyebrow at some repeated names. No, we’re not talking about Dan S Sullivan and Dan J Sullivan , two Republicans with the same name running for US Senate – an issue that went to the state supreme court earlier this summer. We’re talking about the Begiches. Nick Begich III , a Republican, is currently leading the race to represent Alaska in the US House of Representatives for a second term while Tom Begich , a Democrat, is advancing to the general election for governor in November. Continue reading...
body.zh: 现任议员沙利文正在竞选第三个任期，而佩尔托拉正在努力翻转席位并帮助民主党重新夺回国会控制权。随着阿拉斯加州73%的选票计票完毕，11月份的美国参议院选举似乎将包括前民主党女众议员玛丽·佩尔托拉和现任共和党人丹·S·沙利文之间的对决。佩尔托拉在 X 上发帖称：“今晚，阿拉斯加人已经兴奋不已，准备好在参议院发出独立的声音，他将修复被操纵的系统，降低成本，并将阿拉斯加放在第一位。” “我们已经准备好在 11 月 3 日赢得胜利。”民主党的目标是在美国参议院大选中击败共和党人阿什利穆迪。去年，德桑蒂斯任命穆迪接替马可·卢比奥出任国务卿，穆迪赢得了 11 月举行的几乎象征性的初选，完成了卢比奥剩余两年的任期。据《迈阿密先驱报》报道，出生于杰克逊维尔的尼克松强烈反对德桑蒂斯的政策，包括今年春天在州长办公室静坐，抗议共和党重新划分选区。那次示威导致她面临侵入和抵抗的轻罪指控，她正在法庭上抗辩。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As candidates vie for public office, this verse reminds us that true leadership is marked by humility and a genuine concern for others. It challenges those seeking power to prioritize the well-being of the community over personal ambition. For citizens, it encourages discernment about the character and motivations of those who aspire to serve.
reflection.zh: 当候选人竞逐公职时，这节经文提醒我们，真正的领导力以谦卑和对他人的真诚关怀为标志。它挑战那些寻求权力的人，要将社区的福祉置于个人抱负之上。对于公民而言，它鼓励我们辨别那些渴望服务的人的品格和动机。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: Government rough sleeping funding may not ‘be enough’ to tackle problem, says Burnham – UK politics live
title.zh: 伯纳姆称政府露宿者资助或“不足以”解决问题——英国政治直播

summary.en: The UK Prime Minister has pledged to get rough sleepers off the streets for Christmas, but a government official, Andy Burnham, expressed concern that current funding might not be sufficient. He issued a rallying call for community and voluntary organizations to assist with the plan.
summary.zh: 英国首相承诺在圣诞节前让露宿者离开街头，但一位政府官员安迪·伯纳姆表示，目前的资金可能不足以解决这个问题。他呼吁社区和志愿组织协助实施该计划。

body.en: PM pledges to get rough sleepers off streets for Christmas but issues ‘rallying call’ for community and voluntary organisations to help with plan Andy Burnham has admitted government funding “may not fully be enough” to achieve his aim of offering a place to stay to every rough sleeper by Christmas, as he made a “rallying call” for communities to get behind his plan. Speaking on a visit to the north-east of England, the prime minister said: The government money itself may not fully be enough. So I am saying, putting the call out to community and voluntary organisations – we’re at one here in Newcastle today, doing fantastic work. But we’re saying to the wider community, voluntary, and faith sector: come on, let’s get behind this. Let’s show what Britain can do when we all pull in the same direction. We did it in the pandemic, we can do it again, and it’s a rallying call, really, that I’m putting out there today with a lot of government money behind it. We did bring the numbers right down, but because we were the only area providing a high level of support, more people started to travel and it became difficult. Continue reading...
body.zh: 总理承诺圣诞节期间让露宿者不再上街，但向社区和志愿组织发出“集会号召”来帮助制定计划安迪·伯纳姆承认，政府资金“可能不足以”实现他在圣诞节前为每个露宿者提供住宿的目标，他呼吁社区支持他的计划。首相在访问英格兰东北部时表示：政府资金本身可能还不够。所以我要向社区和志愿组织发出呼吁——我们今天在纽卡斯尔，做了出色的工作。但我们要对更广泛的社区、志愿者和信仰部门说：来吧，让我们支持这一点。让我们展示一下，当我们齐心协力时，英国能做些什么。我们在大流行中做到了这一点，我们可以再次做到这一点，这确实是一个集会号召，我今天在政府的大量资金支持下发出了这一号召。我们确实降低了人数，但由于我们是唯一提供高水平支持的地区，更多的人开始旅行，这变得很困难。继续阅读...

body.en: Sunday incident created ‘significant traffic disruptions’ and a foul odor as crews worked to clear cephalopod remains More than 20 tons of squid spilled on to a Rhode Island highway during a traffic accident, creating hours of delays for motorists and a foul stench as crews worked in baking sunshine to scrape up the remains of the fast-decaying cephalopods. The incident occurred Sunday morning in Narragansett when the driver of a tractor-trailer transporting the squid failed to make a turn, and the vehicle fell on to its side, the town’s police department said in a statement, reported by ABC News . title.en: Six tourists and pilot killed in Kenya helicopter crash
title.zh: 肯尼亚直升机失事 六名游客和飞行员丧生

summary.en: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Department tells the BBC the nationalities are yet to be confirmed.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Six tourists and a pilot have been killed after a helicopter crashed at Mount Ololokwe in central Kenya, air accident officials have told the BBC.

The Aircraft Accident Investigation Department said the nationalities of the pilot and passengers were yet to be confirmed.

The Kenya Civil Aviation Authority (KCAA) said the accident happened in Samburu county at approximately 09:13 local time (06:13 GMT).

It said the helicopter was on a scenic flight from a wildlife conservancy in Loisaba to Ewaso Nyiro, a river that flows along several national reserves.

The Kenya Red Cross has told the BBC that the area is not yet accessible, but drones are being used to assess the scene.

The KCAA said the accident involved a Eurocopter EC130 B4 and it was co-ordinating operations.

The transport ministry and Air Accident Investigations Department would lead "investigations into the circumstances surrounding the accident", it added.

Samburu county is a popular tourist destination with many private wildlife conservancies and is renowned for its stunning scenery.

In February, a helicopter crash in the Rift Valley county of Nandi killed six people, including a member of parliament.

In 2024, the military chief, Gen Francis Omondi Ogolla, died after an army helicopter that was carrying 11 people crashed in the west of the country, with only two survivors.

In June 2021 at least 10 soldiers were killed when their helicopter crashed while landing near the capital, Nairobi.
body.zh: 空难官员告诉英国广播公司，一架直升机在肯尼亚中部奥洛洛奎山坠毁，造成六名游客和一名飞行员死亡。 飞机事故调查部门表示，飞行员和乘客的国籍尚未确定。 肯尼亚民航局（KCAA）表示，事故发生在桑布鲁县，时间约为当地时间 09:13（格林威治标准时间 06:13）。 据称，这架直升机正在从洛伊萨巴野生动物保护区飞往埃瓦索尼罗河（Ewaso Nyiro）的观光飞行中，埃瓦索尼罗河是一条流经多个国家保护区的河流。 肯尼亚红十字会告诉英国广播公司，该地区目前还无法进入，但正在使用无人机评估现场。 KCAA 表示，事故涉及一架欧洲直升机公司 EC130 B4，该公司正在协调行动。 它补充说，交通运输部和航空事故调查部将牵头“对事故相关情况进行调查”。 桑布鲁县是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地，拥有许多私人野生动物保护区，并以其迷人的风景而闻名。 2月，南迪裂谷县发生的一次直升机坠毁事件造成六人死亡，其中包括一名议员。 2024 年，一架载有 11 人的军用直升机在该国西部坠毁，军事首长弗朗西斯·奥蒙迪·奥古拉 (Francis Omondi Ogolla) 将军身亡，只有两名幸存者。 2021 年 6 月，至少 10 名士兵乘坐的直升机在首都内罗毕附近降落时坠毁。

title.en: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
title.zh: 乌克兰男子因北溪管道爆炸案在克罗地亚被捕

summary.en: A Ukrainian man has been arrested in Croatia in connection with the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline blasts. He is alleged to have been one of the scuba divers involved in planting explosives on the pipelines.
summary.zh: 一名乌克兰男子因涉嫌2022年北溪天然气管道爆炸案在克罗地亚被捕。据称，他曾是参与在管道上安放炸药的潜水员之一。

body.en:
A Ukrainian man has been arrested in Croatia on suspicion of taking part in the bombing of the Nord Stream gas pipelines between Russia and Germany.

The suspect is alleged by German authorities to have been one of the scuba divers who planted explosives on the pipelines in September 2022, following Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

He is the second man to be arrested over the plot, which has strained relations between Kyiv and Berlin - one of the key European backers for Ukraine's war effort.

"The suspect participated in the necessary dives" for the sabotage, German prosecutors alleged, adding they were pursuing the suspect's extradition from Croatia.

Prosecutors identified the man only as trained scuba diver Vladimir Z, however he is understood to be Volodymyr Zhuravlyov, who was arrested in Poland in 2025 over the undersea plot.

In that case, a Polish judge refused a German extradition request, arguing that if Ukraine was responsible for the attack, then it was a "just" act.

Zhuravlyov was then released, prompting a ripple of surprise from the crowd in court and a smile from the man in the dock.

The other suspect in the case is former Ukrainian military officer Serhiy Kuznetsov. He was arrested in Italy in August 2025 and later extradited to Germany where he is set to face trial. He has denied responsibility for the explosions and appeared before a court in Hamburg in June.

Prosecutors allege Kuznetsov led a team that used a yacht rented at Rostock in Germany to plant explosives on the pipelines close to the Danish Baltic Sea island of Bornholm.

Although the Nord Stream 1 pipeline was in operation at the time, Nord Stream 2 had yet to go into service.

After his planned extradition from Croatia, they say he will be brought before an investigating judge to face charges of causing explosions and sabotage.

Blame for the blasts, which crippled a long-controversial energy supply line from Russia to Germany, initially focused on Moscow until signs of Ukrainian involvement began to emerge.

Poland was always been a vocal critic of the pipeline project with Russia, arguing it made Berlin too dependent on Moscow. The route also deprived Poland of transit fees for the gas. Ukraine and the US were also longstanding opponents of the pipelines.
body.zh: 一名乌克兰男子因涉嫌参与俄罗斯和德国之间的北溪天然气管道爆炸事件而在克罗地亚被捕。 德国当局指控嫌疑人是 2022 年 9 月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后在管道上放置炸药的潜水员之一。 他是第二名因这一阴谋而被捕的人，该阴谋导致基辅和柏林之间的关系紧张——柏林是乌克兰战争努力的欧洲主要支持者之一。 德国检察官声称，“嫌疑人参与了必要的潜水”以进行破坏活动，并补充说他们正在寻求从克罗地亚引渡嫌疑人。 检察官只确认该男子是受过训练的水肺潜水员 Vladimir Z，但据了解他是 Volodymyr Zhuravlyov，2025 年因海底阴谋在波兰被捕。 在那起案件中，一名波兰法官拒绝了德国的引渡请求，认为如果乌克兰对这次袭击负责，那么这是一个“公正”的行为。 朱拉夫廖夫随后被释放，法庭上的人群发出一阵惊讶，被告席上的男子也微笑起来。 该案的另一名嫌疑人是前乌克兰军官谢尔盖·库兹涅佐夫。他于 2025 年 8 月在意大利被捕，随后被引渡到德国接受审判。他否认对爆炸负责，并于六月在汉堡法庭出庭。 检察官指控库兹涅佐夫带领一个小组，利用在德国罗斯托克租用的一艘游艇，在丹麦波罗的海博恩霍尔姆岛附近的管道上安放炸药。 尽管北溪1号管道当时已投入运营，但北溪2号管道尚未投入使用。 他们表示，在他计划从克罗地亚引渡后，他将被带见调查法官，面临造成爆炸和破坏的指控。 这次爆炸导致了一条长期备受争议的从俄罗斯到德国的能源供应线瘫痪，最初的责任主要集中在莫斯科，直到乌克兰参与其中的迹象开始出现。 波兰一直直言不讳地批评与俄罗斯的管道项目，认为这使柏林过于依赖莫斯科。这条路线还免除了波兰的天然气过境费。乌克兰和美国也是该管道的长期反对者。

reflection.en: Acts of sabotage, like the alleged pipeline blasts, remind us of the destructive cycle that violence can unleash. Yahweh's word warns that those who live by destructive means often face destruction themselves. May we seek paths that break these cycles, rather than perpetuate them.
reflection.zh: 破坏行为，例如据称的管道爆炸事件，提醒我们暴力可能释放的破坏性循环。雅伟的话语警告我们，那些以破坏性手段生活的人，往往自己也会面临毁灭。愿我们寻求打破这些循环的道路，而不是使其延续。

title.en: Israeli army orders criminal investigation into killing of Palestinian girl Hind Rajab in Gaza
title.zh: 以色列军队下令对加沙巴勒斯坦女孩 Hind Rajab 遇害事件进行刑事调查

summary.en: The five-year-old spent hours on the phone to paramedics before her body was recovered days later in Gaza City in 2024.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The Israeli army has ordered a criminal investigation into the killing in Gaza of five-year-old Hind Rajab, whose death was internationally condemned after a desperate recording of her speaking to paramedics was broadcast around the world.

The Palestinian child was one of seven family members travelling in a vehicle that came under Israeli fire in Gaza City in January 2024.

She initially survived the attack that killed several family members, but her body was recovered days later along with her relatives and two paramedics who had tried to save her in an ambulance.

In a statement, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said that "following a review of the findings" and "due to alleged failures in the coordination of the movement of the Palestine Red Crescent ambulance, it has been decided to initiate a criminal investigation of the incident by Military Police Criminal Investigation Division".

This is the first time the IDF has admitted opening fire on the vehicle carrying Hind and her family. Previously the IDF said its initial investigation suggested no Israeli troops had been in the area at the time of the incident.

Hind Rajab's car was hit by Israeli fire as she and her family tried to flee bombing during the war in Gaza.

Several family members were killed, but Hind managed to answer a callback from the helpers at the Palestinian Red Crescent Society, which lasted hours. Her pleas for someone to rescue her ended when the phone line was cut amid the sound of more gunfire.

The ambulance trying to reach her was also shelled, and the bodies of Hind, her family, and the ambulance crew were all later found.
body.zh: 以色列军队已下令对五岁女孩欣德·拉贾布在加沙被杀的事件进行刑事调查。在她与医护人员绝望地交谈的录音在世界各地播出后，她的死亡受到了国际社会的谴责。 2024 年 1 月，这名巴勒斯坦儿童是乘坐一辆车在加沙城遭到以色列炮火袭击的七名家庭成员之一。 她最初在导致几名家庭成员死亡的袭击中幸存下来，但几天后，她的尸体与她的亲戚和两名试图用救护车救她的护理人员一起被找到。 以色列国防军在一份声明中表示，“在对调查结果进行审查后”，“由于据称巴勒斯坦红新月会救护车的行动协调失败，因此决定由宪兵刑事调查司对这一事件启动刑事调查”。 这是以色列国防军首次承认向载有欣德及其家人的车辆开火。以色列国防军此前表示，初步调查显示，事件发生时没有以色列军队在该地区。 加沙战争期间，欣德·拉贾布 (Hind Rajab) 和家人试图逃离轰炸，她的汽车被以色列炮火击中。 几名家庭成员被杀，但海因德设法回复了巴勒斯坦红新月会帮助者的回电，这个电话持续了几个小时。当电话线在更多枪声中被切断时，她恳求有人来救她。 试图赶到她身边的救护车也遭到炮击，海因德、她的家人和救护人员的尸体后来都被发现了。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Head-on collision between bus and lorry in Brazil kills more than 20
title.zh: 巴西公交车与卡车迎头相撞 造成20多人死亡

summary.en: It is not yet clear what caused the two vehicles to crash into each other in the early hours of Wednesday morning.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
At least 21 people have been killed and another four injured in a head-on collision between a minibus and a lorry in southern Brazil, local officials say.

The crash happened at around 04:30 local time (07:30 GMT) on the BR-373 highway in the southern state of Paraná.

Local media reported that the minibus belonged to the health authorities of the nearby city of Imbituva and was transporting patients and their relatives to health appointments in Ponta Grossa, some 60km (36 miles) away.

Authorities have opened an investigation to determine what may have caused the two vehicles to crash into each other.

The highway has been closed while forensic experts and members of Brazil's federal highway police examine the site of the crash, which is located at kilometre 209.

According to a study published by the World Bank, more than 34,000 people died in such accidents in 2023, most of them were motorcyclists.

Research suggests excessive speed, inebriated drivers and the use of mobile phones while driving is often the cause.

In February, 15 people died on board a bus carrying pilgrims to a festival in the north-eastern state of Ceará.
body.zh: 当地官员称，巴西南部一辆小巴与一辆卡车正面相撞，造成至少 21 人死亡、另外 4 人受伤。 事故发生在当地时间 04:30 左右（格林威治标准时间 07:30），发生在南部巴拉那州的 BR-373 高速公路上。 当地媒体报道称，这辆小巴属于附近城市因比图瓦的卫生当局，正在运送患者及其亲属前往约 60 公里（36 英里）外的蓬塔格罗萨（Ponta Grossa）进行医疗预约。 当局已展开调查，以确定两辆车相撞的原因。 高速公路已关闭，法医专家和巴西联邦高速公路警察成员正在检查位于 209 公里处的事故现场。 根据世界银行发布的一项研究，2023年有超过34,000人死于此类事故，其中大多数是摩托车手。 研究表明，超速、醉酒驾驶以及驾驶时使用手机往往是原因。 2月份，一辆载着朝圣者前往东北部塞阿拉州参加节日的巴士上有15人死亡。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

title.en: Pakistan: Could ex-PM Imran Khan make a new deal?
title.zh: 巴基斯坦：前总理伊姆兰·汗能否达成新协议？

summary.en: The imprisoned former prime minister of Pakistan was moved to a hospital for medical treatment, ushering speculation over the possibility of new political negotiations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The imprisoned former prime minister of Pakistan was moved to a hospital for medical treatment, ushering speculation over the possibility of new political negotiations.

Pakistan's Supreme Court on Tuesday ordered jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan to be shifted to a private hospital after Khan's family and political supporters repeatedly raised concerns about the 73 year old's deteriorating health in Rawalpindi's Adiala jail. 

The founder of the opposition party Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) has been imprisoned since August 2023 and is currently serving a 14-year sentence on corruption charges he says are politically motivated.

The former prime minister was ousted in a parliamentary no-confidence vote in April 2022. Khan and his supporters say Pakistan's influential military is trying to keep him out of politics, an allegation the military denies.

Despite his remaining behind bars, Khan remains politically popular. Despite a crackdown on the PTI following Khan's arrest, the candidates backed by him performed strongly in the February 2024 elections.

"Three years in prison have not removed Khan from Pakistani politics. He remains PTI's biggest political asset, but the party's reliance on him has also exposed weaknesses in its leadership and organization," Raza Rumi, a US-based Pakistani political analyst, told DW.

The transfer of Khan to the Shifa International Hospital in Islamabad for medical assessment has added a new dimension to the debate over his future and the possibility of political negotiations.

However, Khan's adviser Sayed Zulfi Bukhari rejected speculation that court decision was the result of any political deal with the government.

"There is no deal between Imran Khan and anyone. This is the Supreme Court's decision, which is very much welcomed," Bukhari said.

Pakistan's Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar said in a video statement issued on Tuesday night that the government would challenge the Supreme Court order , claiming it was unlawful.

The minister said a convicted prisoner must be treated inside the jail or at a public hospital according to law, adding that he was requesting Khan's medical tests be carried out at a government hospital instead of a private facility.

"Legally, Khan has not been granted bail nor have his convictions been suspended. He will remain a prisoner, and the hospital executive ward shall serve as a sub-jail. Unfortunately, most ordinary prisoners with far more serious ailments are never allowed such facilities by the courts," Osama Malik, a legal expert, told DW. 

Pakistan's Minister of State for Interior, Talal Chaudhry, told DW that "Khan's cases will be decided by the courts."

body.zh: 被监禁的巴基斯坦前总理被转移到医院接受治疗，引发了人们对新政治谈判可能性的猜测。 巴基斯坦最高法院周二下令将被监禁的前总理伊姆兰·汗转移到一家私立医院，此前汗的家人和政治支持者多次对这位 73 岁的前总理伊姆兰·汗在拉瓦尔品第阿迪亚拉监狱中健康状况恶化表示担忧。 反对党巴基斯坦正义运动 (PTI) 创始人自 2023 年 8 月以来一直被监禁，目前正在服刑 14 年，罪名是他所说的出于政治动机的腐败指控。 这位前总理在 2022 年 4 月的议会不信任投票中被赶下台。汗和他的支持者表示，巴基斯坦有影响力的军方正试图让他远离政治，但军方否认了这一指控。 尽管汗仍在狱中，但他在政治上仍然很受欢迎。尽管汗被捕后 PTI 遭到打压，但他支持的候选人在 2024 年 2 月的选举中表现强劲。 驻美国的巴基斯坦政治分析人士拉扎·鲁米 (Raza Rumi) 告诉德国之声：“三年监禁并没有将汗从巴基斯坦政治中剔除。他仍然是巴基斯坦正义党最大的政治资产，但该党对他的依赖也暴露了其领导和组织方面的弱点。” 汗被转移到伊斯兰堡希法国际医院接受医疗评估，这为有关他的未来和政治谈判可能性的争论增添了新的维度。 然而，汗的顾问赛义德·祖尔菲·布哈里否认了法院判决是与政府达成任何政治协议的结果的猜测。 “伊姆兰·汗和任何人之间都没有达成协议。这是最高法院的决定，非常受欢迎，”布哈里说。 巴基斯坦法律部长阿扎姆·纳齐尔·塔拉尔在周二晚发布的视频声明中表示，政府将对最高法院的命令提出质疑，声称该命令是非法的。 该部长表示，根据法律，被定罪的囚犯必须在监狱或公立医院接受治疗，并补充说，他要求汗的医学检查在政府医院而不是私人机构进行。 法律专家奥萨马·马利克（Osama Malik）告诉德国之声：“从法律上讲，汗没有获得保释，他的定罪也没有被暂停。他仍将是囚犯，医院的行政病房将作为分监狱。不幸的是，大多数患有严重疾病的普通囚犯都不会被法院允许使用此类设施。” 巴基斯坦内政部长塔拉勒·乔杜里 (Talal Chaudhry) 告诉德国之声，“汗的案件将由法院裁决。” PTI 的布哈里告诉德国之声，汗“在……期间没有得到正确的医疗护理”。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to leadership, wisdom, and public responsibility. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with wisdom, integrity, and service, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Christian metal band Demon Hunter sue Netflix over KPop Demon Hunters
title.zh: 基督教金属乐队恶魔猎手因韩流恶魔猎手起诉 Netflix

summary.en: The band say they face "an existential crisis" after the success of the K-pop-inspired Netflix film.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及在压力下的忠信与属灵勇气。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Christian metal band Demon Hunter are suing Netflix in a trademark lawsuit over the streamer's hit film Kpop Demon Hunters.

The US group, who have been releasing music and touring for 25 years, said Netflix's plan for a global concert tour, along with the movie and merchandise, means there is "almost complete overlap" with their offerings.

Filed on Tuesday by the band's company Hyde Lane, the complaint claims Netflix Studios and live promoter AEG Presents have caused "substantial confusion" among consumers.

They included email evidence from someone who allegedly spent $500 on tickets for a Demon Hunter concert in New York, thinking it was a child-friendly Kpop show for their small children.

Other examples cited include a television producer who reportedly contacted the band's management thinking they were related to Kpop Demon Hunters, and social media posts incorrectly tagging Demon Hunter when discussing the film.

The five-piece Seattle band, who play "aggressive yet emotionally stirring heavy metal" according to AllMusic , external , released their 12th album in September 2025 and have 350,000 monthly listeners on Spotify.

By comparison, the KPop Demon Hunters cast have 27 million monthly listeners on the streaming platform.

The legal complaint said: "The brand that Hyde Lane has carefully built over the course of the past quarter century now faces an existential crisis, thereby necessitating the filing of this action and the granting of the requested relief from this Court."

The metal band have asked the court to stop Netflix using the KPop Demon Hunters name for recorded music, live shows and merchandise, and to award unspecified damages.

The band's company registered "Demon Hunter" as a trademark for recorded music and merchandise in 2022, and have applied for a trademark in relation to live music.

Netflix has registered "Kpop Demon Hunters" as a trademark for a number of merchandise uses, with other applications pending.

What started as a 2025 animated film following K-pop girl group Huntr/X, Kpop Demon Hunters has grown into a worldwide phenomenon, with music releases and extensive merchandise, with a global live tour expected to begin in 2027.

It is the most-watched original title in Netflix history and won best animated film and best original song for Golden at the 2026 Golden Globes and Oscars.

A sequel to Kpop Demon Hunters is also in the works, while Netflix is reportedly considering , external other follow-up projects such as a television series and stage musical.
body.zh: 基督教金属乐队《恶魔猎手》正在就 Netflix 的热门电影《韩国流行音乐恶魔猎手》提起商标诉讼。 这家美国集团已经发行音乐和巡演 25 年了，他们表示 Netflix 的全球巡回演唱会计划以及电影和商品意味着与他们的产品“几乎完全重叠”。 乐队所属公司 Hyde Lane 于周二提起诉讼，称 Netflix Studios 和现场推广公司 AEG Presents 在消费者中造成了“严重混乱”。 其中包括某人的电子邮件证据，据称该人花费 500 美元购买了纽约恶魔猎人音乐会的门票，认为这是一场适合他们小孩的韩流表演。 引用的其他例子包括，据报道，一名电视制片人联系了乐队的管理层，认为他们与韩流恶魔猎手有关，而社交媒体帖子在讨论这部电影时错误地标记了恶魔猎手。 据 AllMusic 外部报道，这支西雅图五人乐队演奏的是“咄咄逼人而又激动人心的重金属”，于 2025 年 9 月发行了他们的第 12 张专辑，每月在 Spotify 上拥有 35 万听众。 相比之下，《KPop Demon Hunters》演员在流媒体平台上每月拥有 2700 万听众。 法律诉状称：“海德巷在过去四分之一个世纪中精心打造的品牌现在面临着生存危机，因此有必要提起这一诉讼并批准本法院所请求的救济。” 这支金属乐队已请求法院阻止 Netflix 在录制的音乐、现场表演和商品中使用 KPop Demon Hunters 的名称，并判给未具体说明的损害赔偿金。 该乐队的公司于 2022 年将“Demon Hunter”注册为录制音乐和商品的商标，并已申请与现场音乐相关的商标。 Netflix 已将“Kpop Demon Hunters”注册为多种商品用途的商标，其他申请正在等待中。 《Kpop Demon Hunters》最初是一部 2025 年推出的动画电影，讲述了韩国流行女子组合 Huntr/X 的故事，现已发展成为全球现象级现象，发布了音乐和大量商品，预计将于 2027 年开始全球现场巡演。 它是 Netflix 历史上收视率最高的原创作品，并在 2026 年金球奖和奥斯卡颁奖典礼上为 Golden 赢得了最佳动画电影和最佳原创歌曲。 《韩国流行音乐恶魔猎手》的续集也在制作中，而据报道 Netflix 正在考虑推出其他后续项目，例如电视剧和舞台音乐剧。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to faithfulness under pressure and spiritual courage. Hebrews 10:23 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with steadfast faith and prayerful witness, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Fact check: How do I spot fake social media accounts, bots and trolls?
title.zh: 事实核查：如何发现虚假社交媒体帐户、机器人和巨魔？

summary.en: If you are unsure whether to trust a message on TikTok or X, study its source. The following indicators can help you determine if you are dealing with a fake account, bot or troll.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 如果您不确定是否信任 TikTok 或 X 上的消息，请研究其来源。以下指标可以帮助您确定您是否正在与虚假帐户、机器人或巨魔打交道。 数十万个不真实​​的社交媒体帐户。数以万计的假文章。数以百万计的自动帖子。 这些是德国外交部引用的一些与俄罗斯虚假信息活动有关的数据，该活动于 2022 年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后首次被发现。 该行动被称为“Doppelgänger”，旨在放大德国等国家社交媒体平台上的亲俄言论。 该部在 2024 年的一份报告中表示，在某些日子里，数千个账户处于活跃状态，以协调的方式每秒发布一次以上。 此活动强调了用户验证社交媒体帐户的真实性并识别内容何时被机器人和巨魔发布或放大的重要性。 但首先，机器人和巨魔之间有什么区别？你如何发现它们？ DW 事实检查提供了一些提示来帮助您驾驭当今的信息格局。 虚假帐户是隐藏其真实身份的社交媒体资料。有些可能会冒充普通用户；其他人可以冒充政客、机构或记者。 并非所有虚假帐户都有恶意。有些人可能会使用假名来保护自己的身份或出于安全原因。活动人士或举报人可能会使用虚假帐户来调查敏感问题。 机器人（机器人的简称）不知疲倦地评论帖子、分享内容，或人为地引发关于边缘或其他被忽视主题的在线辩论。有时，他们完全是无辜的，但有时他们的意图是有害的。 好的机器人可以自动在社交媒体上分享新闻或天气预报，以及地震警报和卫星图像。 相比之下，坏机器人旨在模仿真正的人类活动以推进特定议程。 根据算法的不同，此类计算机程序可以撰写和发布社交媒体帖子或评论、关注他人，甚至发送好友请求。 坏机器人可以通过在社交媒体平台上放大某些政治观点并人为地引起对某些问题的关注来扭曲现实。 另一方面，巨魔是真实的人类，他们表现出破坏性和过度活跃的在线行为。 有些人甚至受雇骚扰某些公众人物或媒体组织，作为所谓的巨魔工厂或农场的一部分。 巨魔工厂最突出的例子之一是俄罗斯圣彼得堡的互联网研究机构。 EUvsDisinfo 是欧洲的一个项目...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to truth, discernment, and honest speech. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with discernment and truthful speech, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到真理、分辨与诚实。Philippians 4:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以分辨与诚实表达来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: 'Power of the purse': What Trump stands to lose in US midterm test
title.zh: “钱袋子”的力量：特朗普在美国中期选举中可能失去什么

summary.en: As midterm primaries continue with elections in several states this week, analysts are predicting a shake-up in the political landscape, indicating potential shifts in influence for former President Trump.
summary.zh: 随着本周几个州中期初选的继续进行，分析人士预测政治格局将发生变化，预示着前总统特朗普的影响力可能出现转变。

body.en:
The 2026 United States midterm elections will be a crucial test of Donald Trump's political strength, with Democrats hoping to regain control of Congress and Republicans seeking to defy the historical tendency for a president's party to lose ground halfway through a term.

The November elections will determine control of the House of Representatives and could reshape the balance of power in Washington for the final two years of Trump's presidency.

The first midterm primaries were held in March and have continued in recent months, with Alaska, Florida and Wyoming holding their primaries this week.

For Democrats, the November midterms offer an opportunity to demonstrate that dissatisfaction with Trump can translate into electoral gains and to begin rebuilding the party ahead of the next general election in 2028.

For Republicans, the elections will test whether Trump's political strength remains sufficient to protect the party from the historical midterm backlash that has affected many previous administrations.

And for Trump himself, a Democratic-controlled House could mean substantially greater scrutiny, investigations and political resistance during the final years of his presidency.

Wesley Widmaier, a professor at the Australian National University Department of International Relations, told SBS News an overall loss for Trump would restrict his influence.

"The House controls the power of the purse and is where budgets originate in the American system. A Democrat win would mean a loss of a lot of control for Trump," he said.

Ultimately, the midterms could provide the clearest indication yet of whether the political momentum in the US is shifting away from Trump and the Republican Party — or whether Republicans can defy the historical pattern and maintain their grip on Congress.

Every two years, US citizens elect all 435 members of the House of Representatives, while roughly one-third of the Senate is elected.

The House of Representatives has the special power to initiate tax bills and to impeach officials, while the Senate approves presidential appointments, such as judges and cabinet members.

Unlike in Australia, voting in US elections is not compulsory, and midterm elections — those held between presidential elections — tend to have lower voter turnout and less media attention.

But Widmaier said they still have significance for US politics and decision-making.

Historically, the president's party tends to lose ground in the House during midterm elections, he explained.

body.zh: 2026年美国中期选举将是对唐纳德·特朗普政治实力的一次关键考验，民主党希望重新获得对国会的控制权，而共和党则力图打破总统所在政党在任期中途失利的历史趋势。 11 月的选举将决定众议院的控制权，并可能重塑特朗普总统任期最后两年华盛顿的权力平衡。 第一届中期初选于三月举行，近几个月持续进行，阿拉斯加州、佛罗里达州和怀俄明州本周举行初选。 对于民主党人来说，11 月的中期选举提供了一个机会，证明对特朗普的不满可以转化为选举收益，并在 2028 年下一次大选之前开始重建民主党。 对于共和党人来说，这次选举将考验特朗普的政治实力是否仍然足以保护共和党免受历史性中期反弹的影响，这种反弹影响了许多前任政府。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 对于特朗普本人来说，民主党控制的众议院可能意味着在他总统任期的最后几年里会受到更大程度的审查、调查和政治阻力。 澳大利亚国立大学国际关系系教授韦斯利·维德迈尔 (Wesley Widmaier) 告诉 SBS 新闻，特朗普的全面失败将限制他的影响力。 “众议院控制着钱包的权力，是美国体系中预算的来源。民主党获胜将意味着特朗普失去很多控制权，”他说。 最终，中期选举可能会提供迄今为止最清晰的迹象，表明美国的政治势头是否正在从特朗普和共和党手中转移，或者共和党是否能够挑战历史模式并保持对国会的控制。 美国公民每两年选举一次众议院全部 435 名议员，而参议院则选举大约三分之一的议员。 众议院拥有发起税收法案和弹劾官员的特殊权力，而参议院则批准总统任命，例如法官和内阁成员。 与澳大利亚不同，美国选举中的投票不是强制性的，而中期选举（在总统选举之间举行的选举）往往选民投票率较低，媒体关注度也较低。 但维德迈尔表示，它们对美国政治和决策仍然具有重要意义。 他解释说，从历史上看，总统所在的政党往往会在中期选举期间在众议院失利。 “人们对主年度选举中的潜在候选人感到兴奋，然后总会有一些消退......

reflection.en: Elections often highlight the transient nature of human power and influence. This news reminds us that while leaders rise and fall, Yahweh ultimately determines who holds authority and for how long. It encourages us to look beyond immediate political outcomes to the enduring sovereignty of Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 选举常常凸显人类权力和影响力的短暂性。这则新闻提醒我们，尽管领袖兴衰更迭，但雅伟最终决定谁拥有权柄以及拥有多久。它鼓励我们超越眼前的政治结果，看到雅伟永恒的主权。

title.en: In drought-stricken France, tankers supply drinking water
title.zh: 在饱受干旱困扰的法国，油罐车供应饮用水

summary.en: France is experiencing severe water shortages in regions typically abundant in supply, with tankers now delivering drinking water. This summer's extreme heat has revealed a widespread lack of preparedness across the country and Europe for increasing water scarcity.
summary.zh: 法国通常水资源充足的地区正面临严重的水短缺，目前需要通过油罐车供应饮用水。今年夏季的极端高温暴露了法国乃至欧洲大部分地区对日益加剧的水资源短缺缺乏准备。

body.en:
France is seeing water shortages in regions that usually have plenty of supply. This summer's extreme heat is exposing how unprepared much of the country, and Europe, is for increasing water scarcity.

Since early August, huge silver tanker trucks have been paying a visit to the town of Sainte-Marie-aux-Mines in Alsace, eastern France, twice a week. They aren't delivering heating oil or milk, but drinking water from the nearby town of Liepvre.

Sainte-Marie, with its population of 5,000, is located in a green valley in the Vosges Mountains and usually relies on about 20 mountain springs for its water. But the flow rate has fallen after weeks of intense heat and drought .

Liepvre, just a few kilometers away, is connected to a larger water supply network that extends toward the Alsatian plain. Here, there is still enough water despite the drought but because there is no permanent connection between the two systems, tanker trucks are effectively functioning as a water pipeline on wheels.

According to the French government, more than 40,000 people have been affected by water cutoffs or supply disruptions this month, and 550,000 are at higher risk of losing stable access.

The drought has affected large parts of France and water restrictions have been put in place in many regions, but tanker trucks are only being used in certain areas. This depends on what sources or groundwater reserves a municipality relies on for water and whether it can easily switch to other resources.

More than a dozen municipalities in the Jura Mountains, further to the south in the department of Doubs, are also currently being supplied by tanker trucks.

This situation is not new for France . In the summer of 2022, which was also exceptionally dry, tanker trucks were used to supply hundreds of municipalities with water. Others depended on bottled water.

Coucouron, a village in the Massif Central region of southern France with just under 800 residents, was severely affected .

Though it's located at a height of more than 1,000 meters (3,280 feet) in a region rich in water and where three major French rivers — the Loire, the Allier and the Ardeche, have their sources — an important spring ran dry after months of drought. Tanker trucks had to bring water to the villagers for months.

But drought wasn't the only reason for these problems. Experts discovered that there were several major leaks in the water supply network. Once they had been repaired, the village's water consumption dropped by about 40 cubic meters per day. A 6-kilometer-long (3.7-mile) pipeline linking to an additional water source is expected to bring more stability.

title.en: US: Meta hooked children, prosecutors say, as trial over social media harm begins
title.zh: 美国：检方称Meta诱导儿童上瘾，社交媒体危害案开庭

summary.en: Four US states have taken Meta to court, accusing the social media giant of deliberately making Facebook and Instagram addictive for children. Meta has denied the charges.
summary.zh: 四个美国州份已对Meta公司提起诉讼，指控这家社交媒体巨头故意将脸书和Instagram设计成让儿童上瘾的产品。Meta公司否认了这些指控。

body.en:
Four US states have taken Meta to court, accusing the social media giant of deliberately making Facebook and Instagram addictive for children. Meta has denied the charges.

Meta intentionally hooked and exploited children, a US federal court heard Tuesday   as a   landmark trial seeking to hold Meta accountable for the alleged harm its social media platforms cause children began in California.

Four US states, California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey, argue the company misled the public about the safety of Instagram and Facebook and deliberately made the apps addictive for minors.

Lawyers for the states also allege Meta  is violating privacy laws  by routinely collecting data on children under 13 without their parents' consent.

The states are seeking around $200 billion (€173 billion) in damages as well as significant changes to Meta's core platforms.

They are part of a coalition of 29 states that sued the tech giant in 2023 for allegedly building addictive features into its apps.

On Tuesday, opening statements were made in the federal court in Oakland, a short drive from San Francisco.

Megan O'Neill, a deputy attorney general for California, laid out the case to the eight-person jury.

"You're going to hear that Meta knew a lot about kids' brains," O'Neill said. "This includes how they are constantly seeking rewards, how they are sensitive to social feedback and how they are still developing their ability to control impulses the way adults do."

O'Neill said that Meta had researched these vulnerabilities and talked about how its Instagram platform could be changed to respond to them.

She told the court of a Meta study titled 'The young ones are the best ones,' alleging that for the company, "kids are the product."

Meta attorney Paul Schmidt said in his opening statement that there was "no dispute" that some social media users face ​struggles. However, he said that research showed no ‌clear association between adolescents' social media use and their well-being.

Schmidt said that Meta had "tried to come up with tools" to help users who have negative experiences on its apps.

"Much of this lawsuit is about the government attorneys and their witnesses saying, 'in trying to improve, we'd do it a little differently,'" Schmidt said.

He argued that Meta's efforts to improve tools to help users on their platforms had been  "meaningful."

Former Meta employee and expert witness Arturo Bejar testified on Tuesday, despite the company's efforts to block his appearance at the trial.

body.zh: 美国四个州已将 Meta 告上法庭，指控这家社交媒体巨头故意让 Facebook 和 Instagram 让儿童上瘾。梅塔否认了这些指控。 美国联邦法院周二审理了 Meta 故意诱骗和剥削儿童的案件，这是一项具有里程碑意义的审判，旨在要求 Meta 对其社交媒体平台涉嫌对儿童造成的伤害负责。 美国四个州（加利福尼亚州、科罗拉多州、肯塔基州和新泽西州）辩称，该公司在 Instagram 和 Facebook 的安全性问题上误导了公众，并故意让这些应用程序让未成年人上瘾。 各州律师还指控 Meta 未经父母同意经常收集 13 岁以下儿童的数据，违反了隐私法。 各州正在寻求约 2000 亿美元（1730 亿欧元）的损失以及对 Meta 核心平台的重大改变。 他们是由 29 个州组成的联盟的一部分，该联盟于 2023 年起诉这家科技巨头，指控其在其应用程序中内置了令人上瘾的功能。 周二，奥克兰联邦法院发表了开庭陈词，该法院距离旧金山只有很短的车程。 加州副总检察长梅根·奥尼尔向八人陪审团陈述了此案。 “你会听说梅塔对孩子的大脑了解很多，”奥尼尔说。 “这包括他们如何不断寻求奖励，他们如何对社会反馈敏感，以及他们如何像成年人一样发展控制冲动的能力。” 奥尼尔表示，Meta 已经研究了这些漏洞，并谈到了如何改变其 Instagram 平台以应对这些漏洞。 她在法庭上发表了一项题为“年轻人是最好的”的 Meta 研究，声称对于公司来说，“孩子就是产品”。 Meta 律师保罗·施密特 (Paul Schmidt) 在开庭陈述中表示，一些社交媒体用户面临的困境“毫无争议”。然而，他表示，研究表明青少年的社交媒体使用与他们的幸福感之间没有明显的关联。 施密特表示，Meta 已“尝试推出工具”来帮助对其应用程序有负面体验的用户。 “这起诉讼的大部分内容都是关于政府律师和他们的证人说，‘为了改进，我们会采取一些不同的做法，’”施密特说。 他认为 Meta 改进工具以帮助其平台上的用户的努力是“有意义的”。 尽管公司极力阻止他出庭，Meta 前员工兼专家证人 A​​rturo Bejar 仍于周二出庭作证。 这位前 Meta 工程总监表示，在 Facebook 的初期，“目标是能够尽快将东西交到用户手中，这......

reflection.en: This lawsuit highlights the critical need to protect children in the digital age, advocating for those who may not fully grasp the long-term implications of addictive technologies. It reminds us of the call to speak up for the vulnerable, ensuring their well-being is prioritized over corporate interests.
reflection.zh: 这起诉讼凸显了在数字时代保护儿童的迫切需要，为那些可能无法完全理解成瘾技术长期影响的孩子们发声。它提醒我们，要为弱势群体挺身而出，确保他们的福祉优先于企业利益。

title.en: Donald Trump says no Iran talks planned, shares map showing Hormuz as 'new US territory'
title.zh: 特朗普称未计划与伊朗谈判，并分享地图将霍尔木兹海峡标为“美国新领土”

summary.en: US President Donald Trump stated that no talks with Iran are planned, while also sharing a map that depicted the Strait of Hormuz as "new US territory." Iran has maintained its stance that it will not reopen the vital waterway unless the US lifts its blockade of Iranian ports.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，目前没有与伊朗进行谈判的计划，同时他还分享了一张地图，将霍尔木兹海峡标注为“美国新领土”。伊朗坚称，除非美国解除对伊朗港口的封锁，否则不会重新开放这条重要的航道。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has said no talks with Iran are underway and none are scheduled, as he posted a map showing the Strait of Hormuz as a new US territory.

Trump has been pressing his threat to claim sovereignty over the crucial energy waterway as the nearly six-month-old Iran war grinds on with little sign of resolution.

Trump's envoy and son-in-law Jared Kushner had said on Monday that the US and Iran were having "very positive and active conversations", but the president denied that was the case.

"There are no talks or conversations going on, or scheduled, with the Islamic Republic of Iran. The Naval Blockade remains in full force and effect," Trump wrote on his Truth Social network on Tuesday night.

"The Hormuz Strait is open and operating. All water mines have been removed or detonated."

US sources told the Agence-France Presse news agency there had been "positive" discussions with the Iranians, but added that Trump had decided to wait and asked his team not to engage until Iran was ready to make a deal.

In recent weeks, there has been a lull in fighting, though the United Arab Emirates has recently accused Iran of firing two ballistic missiles — which landed at sea — targeting "maritime navigation." Iran, however, denied firing a missile toward the UAE.

Soon after, the UAE announced that "in light of regional escalations" it was halting all trade, commercial exchanges and financial transactions with Iran.

The UAE bore the brunt of Iranian missile and drone attacks in the first period of the war, but had not reported any attacks since the US and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding in June that was meant to halt the fighting.

Earlier on Tuesday, Trump posted a map on Truth Social showing the Strait of Hormuz as a "NEW U.S. Territory".

Iran has effectively shut down the chokepoint , through which a fifth of the world's oil would usually transit, in retaliation for the war launched by the US and Israel in late February.

Trump revisited the idea again earlier in the week in comments to reporters in the Oval Office.

This is not the first time that Trump, faced with a foreign policy obstacle, has threatened to annex foreign territory.

Since returning to power in 2025, he has threatened to make Canada the 51st US state, seize Greenland and Cuba, and has even alluded to taking control of the Gaza Strip, without following through on any of these threats.

Before the Iran war erupted on 28 February, the Strait of Hormuz was an open waterway with free passage.

title.en: Designed to 'exploit' children: Meta faces a historic courtroom reckoning
title.zh: 被指控“剥削”儿童：Meta面临历史性法庭审判

summary.en: Meta is facing a significant trial over allegations that its platforms, Facebook and Instagram, were designed to exploit children. The outcome could lead to substantial penalties and reshape the future of these social media giants.
summary.zh: Meta正面临一场重大审判，被指控其平台Facebook和Instagram被设计用于剥削儿童。审判结果可能导致巨额罚款，并重塑这些社交媒体巨头的未来。

body.en:
Meta knowingly hooked and exploited children, a United States federal court has heard in the trial of the social media giant on charges that it deliberately made Instagram and Facebook addictive to young users.

In what many experts have called social media's "big tobacco moment," a coalition of US states is demanding Meta pay US$200 billion ($282 billion) in penalties for using technology specifically designed to foster addiction among children in a similar fashion to cigarettes.

Meta "exploited how kids' brains work," California prosecutor Megan O'Neill said in opening arguments, painting Meta's business model as one built to "hook the users, hold them for as long as they can, harvest their data, and then hide the truth from the public".

"It worked especially well for kids," O'Neill added. "Meta needed kids, and it needed to reassure the people who cared about those kids that the kids are safe."

Meta's lawyer, Paul Schmidt, acknowledged that some users were harmed by the networks, but argued that the company had "tried to come up with tools to help them". He argued research showed no clear link between adolescents' social media use and a lack of well-being.

He also said Mark Zuckerberg, Meta's co-founder and CEO, shared the company's desire to improve its services, and not make them dangerous.

"They don't believe they're going to do well if people don't like their service," Schmidt said.

Before the trial began, the company denied all the allegations, insisting it had worked with parents, experts and law enforcement to incorporate protective safeguards for children.

This is not the first case seeking to hold tech companies — including Meta — accountable for these types of issues, but it could become one of the most consequential if it leads to sweeping changes on the platforms.

Meta founder and chief Mark Zuckerberg is among the star witnesses expected to testify, along with Instagram head Adam Mosseri.

Activists, including mothers of children they say were driven to suicide by their social media usage, rallied outside court.

One mother, Lori Schott, called out Zuckerberg and Mosseri, saying they "built one of those most powerful and richest companies in the world... But power does not excuse harm."

This is the first federal trial in what is expected to be a tidal wave of lawsuits also targeting TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube as families, educators and state governments charge them with harming the mental health of young people.

Meta, which has more than three billion users worldwide, is the sole defendant in this case.

In addition to financial penalties, the states are demanding changes...
body.zh: 美国联邦法院在对这家社交媒体巨头的审判中获悉，Meta 故意诱骗和剥削儿童，指控其故意让 Instagram 和 Facebook 使年轻用户上瘾。 在许多专家所说的社交媒体“烟草大时刻”，美国各州联盟要求 Meta 支付 2000 亿美元（合 2820 亿美元）的罚款，因为它使用了专门设计的技术，以类似于香烟的方式助长儿童成瘾。 加州检察官梅根·奥尼尔在开庭辩论中表示，Meta“利用了孩子们的大脑工作方式”，并将 Meta 的商业模式描述为“吸引用户，尽可能长时间地保留他们，收集他们的数据，然后向公众隐瞒真相”的商业模式。 “这对孩子们尤其有效，”奥尼尔补充道。 “Meta 需要孩子，它需要让关心这些孩子的人放心，孩子们是安全的。” Meta 的律师保罗·施密特 (Paul Schmidt) 承认，一些用户受到了网络的伤害，但辩称该公司“试图推出工具来帮助他们”。他认为研究表明青少年社交媒体的使用与缺乏幸福感之间没有明显的联系。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他还表示，Meta 的联合创始人兼首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 与该公司一样希望改善其服务，而不是让它们变得危险。 施密特说：“如果人们不喜欢他们的服务，他们就不相信自己会做得很好。” 在审判开始前，该公司否认了所有指控，坚称其已与家长、专家和执法部门合作，纳入对儿童的保护措施。 这并不是第一个寻求让科技公司（包括 Meta）对此类问题负责的案例，但如果它导致平台上发生彻底的变化，它可能会成为最重要的案例之一。 Meta 创始人兼首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 以及 Instagram 负责人亚当·莫塞里 (Adam Mosseri) 都是预计出庭作证的明星证人之一。 活动人士在法庭外集会，其中包括一些自称因使用社交媒体而自杀的孩子的母亲。 一位名叫洛里·肖特 (Lori Schott) 的母亲对扎克伯格和莫塞里表示不满，称他们“建立了世界上最强大、最富有的公司之一……但权力并不能成为伤害的借口。” 这是首次联邦审判，预计将出现一波针对 TikTok、Snapchat 和 YouTube 的诉讼浪潮，因为家庭、教育工作者和州政府指控它们损害年轻人的心理健康。 Meta在全球拥有超过30亿用户，是本案的唯一被告。 除了经济处罚外，各州还要求做出改变……

reflection.en: The gravity of intentionally designing systems that exploit children is immense, as this story highlights. Yahweh's word reminds us of the severe consequences for those who cause the vulnerable to stumble. May this legal process bring accountability and foster environments where children are protected, not exploited.
reflection.zh: 故意设计剥削儿童的系统，其严重性是巨大的，正如这则新闻所强调的。雅伟的话语提醒我们，那些使弱小者跌倒的人将面临严重的后果。愿这场法律程序能带来问责，并促进一个儿童受到保护而非被剥削的环境。

title.en: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history leaves 2,300 dead in Congo
title.zh: 刚果埃博拉疫情迅速蔓延，已致2300人死亡

summary.en: The World Health Organization has reported that the current Ebola outbreak in Congo has claimed 2,300 lives and is on track to become the deadliest on record.
summary.zh: 世界卫生组织报告称，刚果当前的埃博拉疫情已导致2300人死亡，并有望超过有记录以来最致命的疫情。

body.en:
The Democratic Republic of the Congo’s fast-moving Ebola outbreak has now killed over 2,300 people and become the deadliest outbreak of the disease on record in the Central African nation.

The outbreak unfolding in one of DRC's most vulnerable regions is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever, with 4,945 cases including 2,325 deaths, according to government data.

It's the DRC's 17th outbreak, with a toll that has eclipsed that of the country's 2018-2020 outbreak when 2,299 deaths out of 3,481 cases were recorded.

The latest data shows 101 new cases and 33 deaths reported in the previous 24 hours. Over 1,000 people have recovered, while 730 remain in hospitals or isolation.

The outbreak has infected and killed more people at a greater speed than any other outbreak in history. The World Health Organization has said it is on track to surpass the 2014-16 Ebola outbreak in West Africa, the deadliest on record with more than 11,000 deaths.

Trish Newport, emergency coordinator with Doctors Without Borders, said the limited community engagement in the outbreak remains a key challenge.

"The community needs to be aware about the outbreak," she told The Associated Press news agency, adding that people "need to be involved in the response, and they need to know what the signs and symptoms are and what to do if they get sick. And this today is not happening in every single place where there are Ebola cases".

Starting from the first confirmed case, the outbreak reached 2,000 killed almost three times faster than in the 2014-16 outbreak.

Some families have lost up to 15 of their relatives in the epicentre, the Ituri province, Newport said.

"We rapidly need to scale up to be able to prevent more deaths from happening, more families and communities from being impacted," she added.

There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the rare Bundibugyo virus responsible for the current outbreak across six provinces in Congo's east. Trials for those are ongoing in Ituri.

Most new cases and deaths are being reported outside of the people being monitored. Challenges facing medical teams dealing with the outbreak also include strikes by some unpaid health workers, threats by rebel groups, anger from long-traumatised communities, bad roads making it difficult to reach all the affected territories, and misinformation claiming that Ebola isn’t real.

The WHO warned over the weekend that the outbreak is still moving at an "exceptional pace" ahead of efforts to track it, noting that it reached a weekly record of 579 cases and 304 deaths in the previous week.

title.en: Shares in humanoid robot firm Unitree surge 600% on Chinese stock market debut

summary.en: Unitree, the world's largest manufacturer of humanoid robots, experienced a remarkable stock market debut in China, with its shares soaring by over 600%. The company's robots have gained international recognition through videos showcasing their martial arts skills and performances as dancers for pop stars.
summary.zh: 全球最大的人形机器人制造商宇树科技在中国股市首次亮相，股价飙升超过600%。该公司的机器人在展示武术和为流行歌星伴舞的视频中获得了全球声誉。

body.en: Company’s robots have gained global fame via videos of them performing martial arts and as dancers for pop stars Unitree, the world’s biggest humanoid robot maker, has made a spectacular entry on to China’s stock market, with its shares surging by more than 600%. The Chinese company’s robots have gained global fame via viral videos of them performing martial arts , running at Olympic speeds and serving as backup dancers for pop stars. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司的机器人通过表演武术和为流行歌星跳舞的视频而享誉全球。全球最大的人形机器人制造商Unitree已大举进军中国股市，股价飙升逾600%。这家中国公司的机器人因表演武术、以奥运速度奔跑以及为流行歌星担任伴舞等视频而广为人知。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The spectacular market debut of a humanoid robot firm highlights the accelerating pace of technological advancement and the explosion of human knowledge. As we marvel at such innovations, we are reminded of the prophetic insight that knowledge would increase. This rapid progress calls us to seek Yahweh's wisdom for how to steward these powerful new...
reflection.zh: 人形机器人公司的惊人上市，凸显了科技进步的加速和人类知识的爆炸式增长。当我们惊叹于这些创新时，我们被提醒，先知曾预言知识将增加。这种快速的进步呼吁我们寻求雅伟的智慧，以负责任地管理这些强大的新能力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Best of 2026 … so far: Asian mothers, bad feelings: notes on an all-conquering stereotype – podcast
title.zh: 2026年最佳播客回顾：亚洲母亲、负面情绪：关于一个普遍刻板印象的思考

summary.en: The Guardian China podcast series is re-releasing popular audio long reads from 2026, with editorial introductions. This week's featured podcast from April explores the pervasive stereotype of the "tiger mom," often depicted as strict and cold.
summary.zh: 《卫报》中国版播客系列正在重新发布2026年广受欢迎的音频长篇阅读，并附有编辑团队的介绍。本周精选的是四月份的一期播客，探讨了“虎妈”这一普遍存在的刻板印象，即严厉、冷漠的母亲形象。

body.en: Every Wednesday and Friday in August we will publish some of our favourite audio long reads of 2026, in case you missed them, with an introduction from the editorial team to explain why we’ve chosen it. This week, from April: A certain image of the tiger mom – strict, cold and demanding – is ubiquitous in popular culture. Why? By Rebecca Liu. Read by Ginnia Cheng Read the text version here Support the Guardian today: theguardian.com/longreadpod Continue reading...
body.zh: 8 月的每周三和周五，我们将发布一些我们最喜欢的 2026 年音频长读物，以防您错过，并附上编辑团队的介绍，解释我们选择它的原因。本周，从四月开始：“虎妈”的某种形象——严格、冷漠、要求高——在流行文化中无处不在。为什么？作者：丽贝卡·刘。作者：Ginnia Cheng 阅读此处的文字版本 立即支持《卫报》：theguardian.com/longreadpod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: Stereotypes, like the "tiger mom" image, often reduce individuals to a narrow caricature, overlooking the rich complexity of their lives and experiences. Yahweh created every person in His own image, bestowing inherent dignity and worth that transcends any simplistic label. This reminds us to see beyond common assumptions and recognize the unique personhood...
reflection.zh: 刻板印象，例如“虎妈”形象，常常将个人简化为狭隘的漫画式描述，忽视了他们生活和经历的丰富复杂性。雅伟照着自己的形象创造了每一个人，赋予了超越任何简单标签的固有尊严和价值。这提醒我们要超越普遍的假设，认识到每个个体的独特人格。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Pentagon threatens to cut federal funding to 30 universities over foreign academic partnerships
title.zh: 五角大楼威胁削减30所大学的联邦资金，因其外国学术合作关系

summary.en: The Pentagon has threatened to cut federal funding to approximately 30 prominent US universities, including Harvard, Yale, and Stanford. This directive requires these institutions to review and sever foreign academic partnerships deemed a national security risk.
summary.zh: 五角大楼已威胁要削减包括哈佛、耶鲁和斯坦福在内的约30所美国顶尖大学的联邦资金。这项指令要求这些大学审查并切断被五角大楼视为国家安全风险的外国学术合作关系。

body.en: Harvard, Yale, Stanford and others face directive to review and cut alliances Pentagon deems national security risk Thirty US universities could lose federal funding unless they review and cut foreign academic partnerships the Pentagon considers a national security risk within the next two weeks, under a Pentagon directive aimed largely at ties to Chinese institutions. Harvard, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Johns Hopkins, Georgetown and Cornell are among the institutions ordered to conduct and report the reviews – and end partnerships deemed problematic – by 31 August, according to a US official who provided the full list to the Guardian. Continue reading...
body.zh: 哈佛大学、耶鲁大学、斯坦福大学和其他大学面临审查和切断联盟的指令五角大楼认为存在国家安全风险根据五角大楼的一项主要针对与中国机构关系的指令，三十所美国大学可能会失去联邦资助，除非它们在未来两周内审查和切断五角大楼认为构成国家安全风险的外国学术伙伴关系。一位向《卫报》提供完整名单的美国官员表示，哈佛大学、麻省理工学院、约翰·霍普金斯大学、乔治城大学和康奈尔大学等机构被勒令在 8 月 31 日之前进行和报告审查，并结束被视为有问题的合作伙伴关系。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Major policy decisions, especially those impacting academic freedom and international collaboration, highlight the need for comprehensive and wise counsel. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that safety and stability are found in an abundance of good advice, suggesting that broad perspectives are crucial when navigating complex national security concerns. May...
reflection.zh: 重大政策决策，特别是那些影响学术自由和国际合作的决策，凸显了全面而明智的建议的重要性。箴言11:14提醒我们，在众多的谋士中才有安全，这表明在处理复杂的国家安全问题时，广阔的视角至关重要。愿领袖们寻求多元的智慧，以确保决策能服务于所有人的长远利益。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: ‘Bad in every aspect’: derided low-tech animation Niu Lai rivals blockbusters at Chinese box office
title.zh: “各方面都很糟糕”：备受嘲笑的低技术动画《牛来了》在中国票房与大片抗衡

summary.en: A low-tech animated film, initially mocked for its crude quality, has unexpectedly become a box office hit in China, competing with major blockbusters.
summary.zh: 一部因粗糙质量而最初受到嘲笑的低成本动画电影，在中国票房意外走红，与大片竞争。

body.en: Commentary about the ‘so bad it’s good’ qualities of mother and son’s movie has driven people to see it at cinema A crude, low-tech animation about a cow and a skylark has become a sleeper hit at China’s box office, sitting alongside blockbusters such as The Odyssey and Spider-Man: Brand New Day in cinema revenue rankings. Niu Lai, which translates to The Cow is Coming, is an 86-minute budget animation about a newborn calf and a skylark whose relationship develops over the course of an abstract dream sequence. Continue reading...
body.zh: 对母子电影“糟糕透了”的评论促使人们去电影院观看一部关于一头牛和云雀的粗糙、低科技动画在中国票房上取得了巨大成功，与《奥德赛》和《蜘蛛侠：崭新的一天》等大片并列影院收入排行榜。 《牛来》的意思是“牛来了”，这是一部 86 分钟的预算动画，讲述了新生小牛和云雀之间的关系在抽象梦境过程中发展的故事。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story reminds us that true worth and success are not always judged by conventional standards or initial human critique. Yahweh is the one who ultimately determines who rises and who falls, often surprising us with what He chooses to bless.
reflection.zh: 这个故事提醒我们，真正的价值和成功并非总是由传统标准或最初的人类评论来评判。雅伟是最终决定谁兴盛谁衰落的那一位，祂常常以出人意料的方式赐福我们。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: China’s economy showing signs that slowdown may be extending
title.zh: 中国经济放缓迹象或将延长

summary.en: China's economy is experiencing an extended slowdown, with industrial output and retail sales declining in July. This follows one of the country's weakest quarterly growth rates and increases pressure on Beijing for intervention.
summary.zh: 中国经济显示出放缓可能正在加剧的迹象，7月份工业产出和零售额均出现下滑。此前，中国经历了有史以来最疲软的季度增长率之一，这给北京带来了干预的压力。

body.en: Industrial output and retail sales slump in July after one of the country’s weakest quarterly growth rates ever China’s economy is showing signs of extending a slowdown with a slump in industrial output and retail sales in July, adding to pressure on Beijing to intervene with measures to support activity. After the world’s second largest economy posted one of its lowest quarterly growth readings on record in the three months to June, the latest figures suggest it continued to falter in July. Continue reading...
body.zh: 继中国有史以来最弱的季度增长率之一之后，7 月份工业产出和零售销售大幅下滑。随着 7 月份工业产出和零售销售的下滑，中国经济显示出持续放缓的迹象，这加大了北京方面采取干预措施支持经济活动的压力。在这个世界第二大经济体公布了截至 6 月份的三个月以来有记录以来最低的季度增长数据之一后，最新数据显示该经济体 7 月份继续下滑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As a nation faces economic headwinds, it's natural to focus on policy and human intervention. Yet, this moment can also be a reminder that Yahweh is the ultimate source of our ability to create and sustain wealth. In times of plenty or scarcity, remembering His provision helps us anchor our hope beyond fluctuating markets.
reflection.zh: 当一个国家面临经济逆风时，人们自然会关注政策和人为干预。然而，这一刻也可以提醒我们，雅伟是我们创造和维持财富能力的最终来源。无论是在富足还是匮乏之时，记住祂的供应有助于我们将希望锚定在波动市场之外。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Indonesia-China naval drill raises neutrality concerns
title.zh: 印尼与中国海军演习引发中立担忧

summary.en: Indonesia's participation in a limited naval exercise with China near Taiwan has raised questions about its long-standing nonaligned foreign policy.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚与中国海军在台湾附近举行了有限的海上演习，这引发了对其长期不结盟外交政策的担忧。

body.en:
Indonesia maintains a nonaligned foreign policy, but Jakarta's limited participation in a low-level naval exercise with China's navy near Taiwan has drawn scrutiny.

On August 12, an Indonesian frigate briefly joined a naval exercise with China's People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) in waters off Taiwan's east coast, with Taipei asking Jakarta for a reason why it joined the drill.

Indonesian Navy frigate KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai joined the PLAN guided-missile frigate Honghe for what Jakarta described as a "passing exercise." The maneuvers took place during Taiwan's annual Han Kuang military drill. 

An Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson said they were fully aware that the exercise's location "made it particularly sensitive," but stressed that its vessel's presence "was simply part of its transit route back to Indonesia." According to the Taipei Times , the Indonesian vessel was returning from Vladivostok, Russia after an exercise with the Russian navy.  

Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council condemned Beijing's "provocation" after China announced the drill on August 11. Taipei also requested "further details from the Indonesian government" from its Ministry of Foreign Affairs.  

Beijing considers Taiwan to be Chinese territory and has vowed to "reunite" the self-ruled island with the mainland, by using force if necessary . The People's Liberation Army has ratcheted up pressure on Taiwan with frequent military exercises around the island, especially since former US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taipei in 2022.

Amid reactions from Taipei and Washington, the Indonesian Navy stated that its activities with the Chinese Navy were "not warfighting activities in nature" and "not intended as combat training."

Ying-Yu Lin, an associate professor at Taiwan's Tamkang University Graduate Institute of International Affairs and Strategic Studies, told DW that the Chinese exercise with Indonesia had little tactical significance.

"It wasn't as practical as a joint maritime drill, but China wanted to claim its capability in the waters," he said.

However, Ratih Kabinawa, a visiting research fellow at the Japan Institute of International Affairs focusing on Taiwan-Indonesia ties, told DW that regardless of the significance of the drills, Indonesia should have expected some reaction from Taiwan .

"Like it or not, Indonesia is now dragged into this kind of geopolitical gambit," she said.

Kabinawa added that passing exercises were among the lowest-level naval activities yet used by China to justify its intimidation of Taiwan.

"Indonesia must also exercise caution in this regard," she said, adding that Jakarta should "not to be too naive," to assume that its participation in a "regular exercise" with China would not cause concern in...
body.zh: 印度尼西亚维持不结盟的外交政策，但雅加达有限地参与与中国海军在台湾附近举行的低级别海军演习，引起了密切关注。 8月12日，一艘印度尼西亚护卫舰短暂参加了与中国人民解放军海军在台湾东海岸附近海域举行的海军演习，台北向雅加达询问其参加演习的原因。 印度尼西亚海军护卫舰 KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai 与中国海军导弹护卫舰红河号一起进行了雅加达所说的“穿越演习”。这次演习是在台湾一年一度的汉光军演期间进行的。 印度尼西亚外交部发言人表示，他们完全意识到演习地点“使其特别敏感”，但强调其船只的存在“只是其返回印度尼西亚的过境路线的一部分”。据《台北时报》报道，这艘印尼舰艇在与俄罗斯海军演习后正从俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克返回。 中国8月11日宣布演习后，台湾陆委会谴责北京的“挑衅”。台北还要求外交部“提供更多细节”。 北京认为台湾是中国领土，并誓言要让这个自治岛屿与大陆“统一”，必要时会使用武力。特别是自美国前众议院议长南希·佩洛西 2022 年访问台北以来，解放军在台湾频繁进行军事演习，加大了对台湾的压力。 在台北和华盛顿的反应中，印度尼西亚海军表示，其与中国海军的活动“本质上不是战斗活动”，并且“无意进行战斗训练”。 台湾淡江大学国际事务与战略研究所副教授林英宇告诉德国之声，中国与印尼的演习没有什么战术意义。 他说：“这不像联合海上演习那么实际，但中国希望宣示其在该海域的能力。” 不过，日本国际问题研究所研究台印尼关系的客座研究员拉蒂·卡比纳瓦(Ratih Kabinawa)告诉德国之声，无论演习的意义如何，印尼都应该预料到台湾会做出一些反应。 “无论你喜欢与否，印度尼西亚现在都被拖入了这种地缘政治游戏，”她说。 卡比纳瓦补充说，此次演习是中国迄今为止用来证明其恐吓台湾合理性的最低级别的海军活动之一。 她说：“印度尼西亚在这方面也必须保持谨慎。”她补充说，雅加达应该“不要太天真”，认为参加与中国的“定期演习”不会引起人们的担忧……

reflection.en: In a world of complex geopolitical dynamics, nations often strive to maintain peace and neutrality. Indonesia's efforts to navigate its foreign policy amidst regional tensions reflect the ongoing challenge of living at peace with all, as far as it depends on them. This pursuit requires wisdom and a steadfast commitment to de-escalation and understanding.
reflection.zh: 在复杂的地缘政治格局中，各国常努力维持和平与中立。印度尼西亚在区域紧张局势中努力调整其外交政策，反映了在力所能及的范围内与所有人和平相处的持续挑战。这种追求需要智慧和对缓和局势、增进理解的坚定承诺。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: After Hormuz, China looks to the promise – and peril – of the Arctic’s ‘ice silk road’
title.zh: 继霍尔木兹海峡之后，中国着眼于北极“冰上丝绸之路”的机遇与风险

summary.en: China has initiated the first regular shipping transits through the Arctic's northern sea route, aiming to establish an "ice silk road." This new maritime path, however, raises significant concerns regarding its potential environmental impact and geopolitical implications.
summary.zh: 中国已开通北极航线的首次定期运输，旨在建立一条“冰上丝绸之路”。然而，这条新的海上航线在环境影响和地缘政治方面引发了重大担忧。

body.en: China has established the first scheduled transit through the northern sea route, but questions remain over the environmental and political risks When Marco Rubio suggested that the world should look to new shipping lanes to bypass the logjammed strait of Hormuz, it’s unlikely he had the Arctic’s northern sea route in mind. And yet in recent months the promise of this 5,500km channel – cleaved through frozen seas by nuclear-powered icebreakers and illuminated by a sun that never dips below the Arctic horizon – has grown. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国已经建立了第一条通过北方海路的定期过境航线，但环境和政治风险仍然存在问题。当马可·卢比奥建议世界应该寻求新的航道以绕过堵塞的霍尔木兹海峡时，他不太可能想到北极的北方海路。然而近几个月来，这条 5,500 公里长的航道 — — 由核动力破冰船劈开冰冻的海洋，并由永远不会低于北极地平线的太阳照亮 — — 的前景越来越大。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of new trade routes like the Arctic's "ice silk road" highlights humanity's drive for progress and efficiency. Yet, as the story notes, such ventures also carry significant environmental and political risks that demand careful consideration. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to foresee danger and take precautions, rather than rushing headlong into...
reflection.zh: 像北极“冰上丝绸之路”这样的新贸易路线的开辟，彰显了人类对进步和效率的追求。然而，正如报道所指出的，此类项目也伴随着重大的环境和政治风险，需要我们审慎考量。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们预见危险并采取预防措施，而不是为了短期利益而贸然陷入潜在的危机。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: A fake website and a deluge of CVs: the Australian firm embroiled in an FBI probe into alleged Chinese espionage
title.zh: 虚假网站与大量简历：澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查

summary.en: An Australian firm has been caught up in an FBI investigation into alleged Chinese espionage, involving a fake consultancy website that impersonated the Brisbane company. This fake site was among 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice.
summary.zh: 一家澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查，其中涉及一个冒充这家布里斯班公司的虚假咨询网站。这个虚假网站是美国司法部查获的13个网站之一。

body.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued to boast about their defence and security credentials, they became impossible to ignore. From mid-2025, a small Australian consultancy firm called Horizzen started receiving emails and strange calls from people applying for vague jobs in the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：在线冒充布里斯班公司的虚假咨询公司是美国司法部查获的 13 个网站之一 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新更新 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当第一批电子邮件到达时，它们很容易被视为垃圾邮件而被忽略。但随着陌生人继续吹嘘他们的国防和安全资历，他们变得不可能被忽视。从 2025 年中期开始，一家名为 Horizzen 的澳大利亚小型咨询公司开始收到人们在美国申请模糊工作的电子邮件和奇怪的电话。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights how deception, even when elaborately crafted, often has a limited lifespan. summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
An overhaul of the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) has passed the Senate with Coalition support, sent back to the Labor-controlled lower house to be rubber-stamped.

Analysis by the Grattan Institute suggests hundreds of thousands of people will be moved off the scheme or prevented from joining under the changes.

Applicants will be assessed in stages under a new test to determine their functional capacity.

That test is still being developed and will replace the current diagnosis-based model.

Acting CEO of peak body People With Disability Australia Megan Spindler-Smith says her community is grieving.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"There will be harm, there will be injuries. What we're talking about here is that when you reduce people's access to the supports that they need to be able to get out of bed, access the community, go to work, you ostensibly isolate people."

She says many lives will be made smaller by the reforms — which will slash social and community participation supports in half.

"The support needs don't go away when the funding is cut or when the supports are removed. They just get pushed onto either systems or other people, and that means isolation."

Since it started in 2013, the cost of the scheme has ballooned, rising to $50 billion dollars this year, and projected to hit $100 billion within a decade.

The government says its overhaul will slow the scheme’s growth and save almost $38 billion over the next four years.

Greens MPs like Jordon Steele-John say the focus on financial cost has made many disabled people feel like a burden.

“Many people, during the course of this debate, while the government has been trying to push this legislation through, have shared with me that they have felt as though they are being talked about in a way that leaves them feeling like a burden, and that is just not okay.”

Health Minister Mark Butler says reining in spending growth was necessary to safeguard the scheme's financial sustainability and social license.

"This plan puts the scheme back on track, and I'm confident, secures it for decades to come," Butler said.

"It genuinely has transformed the lives of hundreds of thousands of people, and I want to continue to see that happen for decades to come. But we know also that we need to build supports for people who were never intended to be covered by the NDIS, people with more low to moderate support needs, those sorts of second-tier supports that were envisaged by the designers of this amazing reform."

body.en:
Elon Musk's aerospace company SpaceX has retrieved a rocket that splashed down in the Indian Ocean near Christmas Island.

The space debris was towed to the remote island, about 1,500 kilometres off north-west Western Australia, on Tuesday.

"After approx. 24 days at sea, the SpaceX Recovery team successfully guided Starship to a location just off the coast of Christmas Island," the US aerospace manufacturer and launch services company said in a social media post.

"A team of SpaceX engineers is on their way to conduct additional analysis on the vehicle in calmer waters before attempting to return it to Starbase."

Locals in the remote territory reportedly lined up along the rugged coastline to catch a glimpse of the 52-metre-long rocket as it was towed in.

Photographer Chris Bray, who usually focuses on wildlife, said it was not something he ever expected to see.

"This SpaceX Starship was towed into the protected waters around Christmas Island this morning after an unusually gentle landing in the Indian Ocean almost a month ago left it unexpectedly floating and potentially recoverable instead of the usual explosion!" he said on an Instagram post on Tuesday.

Bray's aerial photos show the mostly black-coloured rocket being towed by cable attached to two large ships.

The rocket, which has three large and three small rocket nozzles, appears to have lost some of its outer coating, but was otherwise intact.

The SpaceX website said the company's Starship spacecraft and super heavy rocket were a reusable transport system designed to carry crew and cargo into "orbit, the moon, Mars and beyond".

In 2023, a large gold-coloured dome-like object was found on a beach about 250km north of Perth.

The Australian Space Agency later concluded it was an expended third stage of a polar satellite launch vehicle operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation.

In 1979, parts of NASA's Skylab space station crashed to earth near the sleepy towns of Esperance and Balladonia, triggering a global media frenzy.

body.en:
The leaders of Australia and Thailand have agreed to step up joint efforts to tackle transnational crime, while also pledging to elevate defence and trade ties.

Thailand prime minister Anutin Charnvirakul, in his first visit to Australia since he became leader in late 2025, met with his counterpart Anthony Albanese in Canberra on Wednesday.

The pair agreed to bolster mutual commitments to handle transnational crime, including tasking their law-enforcement agencies to "disrupt increasingly sophisticated global criminal networks", they said in a joint statement.

The nations will also elevate their security relationship by committing to a biannual meeting of defence ministers.

In a boost for Australia's fuel security, Albanese said his counterpart had made the "generous offer" of access to jet fuel, as energy markets experience supply-chain shocks as a result of the US-led war on Iran.

"Building on the strong economic ties is a top priority for my government," he told reporters.

"Times of uncertainty call for greater global cooperation between partners who are reliable and dependable, and friends."

In 2027, Australia and Thailand will mark 75 years since diplomatic relations were established between the two countries.

Anutin said: "I'm confident that our strategic partnership will remain an enduring foundation for Thailand and Australia ... and bring our countries and peoples even closer together."

"I extend my sincere appreciation once again to my dear Prime Minister Albanese and the Australian people for their warm hospitality."

The bid to crack down on transnational crime comes after Thailand tries to alleviate its reputation for being a hotspot for grey money — illicit capital that crosses borders.

The nation is an international hub for online scam work which fleeces millions of dollars from Australians each year.

Vulnerable Thai locals are often imprisoned by criminal syndicates on the outskirts of Bangkok to run the centres.

The Australian Federal Police was involved in a 2025 investigation that led to the arrest of five Australians, as well as United Kingdom, Canadian and South African nationals, operating a scam Bangkok "boiler room".

That announcement also came hours after Thai police confirmed the cause of death of a Thai woman allegedly murdered by an Australian man in June.

The Thai teenager, Tunchanok Donhomla, was allegedly suffocated, according to a police autopsy report seen by the ABC.

Thai police told ABC News that, on the basis of evidence collected, they now believed the investigation was reaching its completion.

title.en: Labor reveals super increase position amid 'predatory' practices crackdown
title.zh: 工党透露在打击“掠夺性”行为中超级增加立场

summary.en: The government drew a line on compulsory superannuation as it unveiled tougher consumer protections.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Labor will not increase how much superannuation employers must pay workers, instead focusing on reforms to stamp out "predatory" practices used to lure people to put retirement savings into risky investments.

The superannuation guarantee rate — the minimum percentage of a worker's earnings that employers must pay into a retirement fund — is 12 per cent, and there have been calls within Labor to raise the rate to 15 per cent.

While rebuffing the need to increase the guarantee rate, the government has doubled down on its defence of the superannuation system amid calls from One Nation to allow workers to withdraw funds before retirement to help pay off mortgages.

"There's no plans to lift the super guarantee," Assistant Treasurer Daniel Mulino, who unveiled the long-awaited consumer protection reforms on Wednesday, told ABC's Radio National.

He said raising the rate to 12 per cent was something Labor had long pushed for and that was now "putting people in a very strong position" for retirement.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Mulino detailed the long-awaited crackdown on predatory practices in an address to the National Press Club on Wednesday, after the high-profile collapses of First Guardian and Shield Master Funds in 2024 and 2025 stripped an estimated 12,000 Australians of their retirement savings.

One Nation has pushed to loosen rules around early access, while the government ruled out any rise to the compulsory super guarantee on Wednesday morning.

The reforms target "lead generators" — operators who use social media, online ads and cold calls to funnel people's retirement into high-risk schemes.

Unlicensed real-time communication about superannuation will be banned, and licensees will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure lead generation activities comply with legal requirements.

The anti‑hawking regime will also be bolstered, with stronger consent requirements, a narrower exemption for financial advisers to existing clients, and harsher penalties for breaches.

Mulino said the reforms were designed to strengthen consumer protections and disrupt "predatory and inappropriate behaviour" that led to the collapse of the Shield and First Guardian funds.

"Lead generators reaching out to these people in unsolicited ways, undertaking highly manipulative interactions to convince them that their super products were not performing well or were inappropriate, and then manipulating them into inappropriate products for them," Mulino told ABC radio on Wednesday morning.

The government previously floated the measures in a consultation paper published in April.

title.en: 'We have let down our partners and families': Suspended Sydney Swans players break silence

body.en:
The five Sydney Swans players stood down after the club found they had breached its standards on the night they were linked to a sexual assault investigation have broken their silence for the first time.

"We are deeply sorry to everyone involved," reads a statement posted to the Sydney Swans website and attributed to all five players.

"We know we have let down our partners and families, members, supporters, teammates, the AFLW team, corporate partners and everyone at the Club and in the wider community."

"We accept the Club sanction and apologise for the impact this has had on those involved."

Sydney Swans chairman Andrew Pridham earlier apologised to the club's fans and corporate partners over the conduct of the five players.

But he did not apologise to the women affected in the incident, confirming the club had made no contact with them as it was a "police matter".

Pridham and Sydney Swans CEO Matthew Pavlich fronted media on Wednesday afternoon, hours after the club confirmed Riley Bice, Nick Blakey, Isaac Heeney, James Jordon and Chad Warner would not be considered for selection for the remainder of the season, including the finals.

The sanctions follow an incident at the Pullman Hotel in East Melbourne that is being investigated by Victoria Police as an alleged sexual assault.

Five players were linked to the investigation and have not been arrested or charged.

However, they said the sanctions were in response to their own "standards breach" — including staying out late, drinking, and "bringing women back to the hotel" — and independent of the Victoria Police investigation.

Asked directly whether the club had apologised to the women involved, Pavlich said the club would not be reaching out.

"It's a police matter, so we're not going to interfere with that by reaching out to them," Pavlich said on Wednesday afternoon.

"We are deeply concerned about their welfare and the wellbeing of those women and we offer as much support as we can."

But Pridham's own apology, delivered at the top of the press conference, was directed elsewhere.

He offered a "sincere apology to the community, to our many fans, our corporate partners, who've been amazingly supportive of us and understanding that we are attempting to deal with this matter as quickly as we can, as honestly as we can".

Pavlich said the club's AFLW team — who play a double-header alongside the men's side this weekend — were "deeply disappointed" by the incident and that "their welfare is of the utmost importance to us".

title.en: I've turned complaints into refunds, results and social change. These are my two secret rules
